request.prompt:
日常随行航拍。设计一台便于日常携带的航拍四旋翼。
四个电机各装一副静止、完全展开的双叶螺旋桨，每个电机只装两片桨叶。
目标部位：航拍相机舱与机身，四处臂根与机身。
本次改变：相机舱与机身读成一个紧凑体量，机臂收拢到机身两侧。
保持：机头朝画面上沿。机载相机朝画面上沿的地平线平视拍摄。制图者从飞机正上方看见相机外壳的顶面，前向镜面在这个视角接近一条边。机身冷灰色。
自由项：舱体安装、机身轮廓、臂根曲面和分件。
Propulsion: 5-inch 2-blade propellers; motor tilt 0°.
4 个电机，True X 布局。最大电机中心距设计值 250 mm，相邻夹角从 R1 起顺时针为 90、90、90、90°。
随附正交俯视定位图，机头朝上，红点定位电机轴心。蓝线表示机架连接。
输出正交俯视产品图，制图观察方向从无人机正上方垂直向下，机头指向画面上沿，完整显示所有电机轴心和桨叶。保持各轴心在定位图画幅内的归一化位置和留白。
浅色中性背景，照片级工业产品设计渲染，柔和棚拍侧光与接触阴影，画面无辅助线、刻度或文字。

configurator_design_fields.instruction:
探索适合日常携带的整机方案。
保留四个电机轴心、相连的机臂和前向相机。
机身外轮廓、相机安装位置与接合方式、机臂过渡、壳体曲面和分件可探索。

provider_revised_prompt: The X-shaped spatial layout and normalized center-frame positioning of the four diagonal motor-axis points in <Picture 1> is <Subject 1>. The target image is a photorealistic orthographic top-down industrial design product render of a compact, portable quadcopter drone folded for everyday carry, aligned to <Subject 1> on a light neutral studio background. <Subject 1> supplies the exact normalized planar positions and spacing transferred to the four motor hubs of the drone. Seen from directly overhead with its nose pointing toward the top edge of the frame, the drone features a cool-gray fuselage and an integrated front camera pod merged into a single compact central volume. At the front of this central body, the airborne camera housing shows its flat top shell, while its forward-facing lens bezel appears nearly as a thin horizontal edge aimed straight ahead toward the top border. Four motor arms are neatly tucked inward along the sides of the fuselage, with smooth curved arm-root housings and clean panel seams connecting seamlessly into the main chassis. Extending outward from the tucked arm tips to the exact coordinates of <Subject 1> are four upright 0-degree-tilt brushless motors arranged in a true X configuration with equal 90-degree angular intervals and symmetrical margins around the perimeter. Each motor mounts a stationary, fully unfolded 5-inch two-blade propeller consisting of exactly two slender dark-gray blades extending in opposite directions across its axis, completely visible within the canvas without overlapping the central body. Soft studio side lighting models the matte cool-gray composite surfaces, subtle bevels, and propeller blades with gentle highlights and soft contact shadows cast onto the seamless light neutral background, with no guide lines, tick marks, or text present.
